title: [Mechanism of Berberis atrocarpa anthocyanin against Alzheimer's disease based on network pharmacology and experimental verification].
authors: Bao, Hai-Yan; Chen, Ling; Yang, Ying; Li, Min; Li, Hui-Min; Kang, Ying-Ying; Li, Jian-Guang
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究小檗果花青素抗阿尔茨海默病的NF-κB/TLR4通路机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: This study aimed to explore the potential mechanism of Berberis atrocarpa Schneid. anthocyanin against Alzheimer's disease(AD) based on network pharmacology, molecular docking technology, and in vitro experiments. Databases were used to screen out the potential targets of the active components of B. atrocarpa and the targets related to AD. STRING database and Cytoscape 3.9.0 were adopted to construct a protein-protein interaction(PPI) network and carry out topological analysis of the common targets. Gene Ontology(GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes(KEGG) enrichment analyses were performed on the target using the DAVID 6.8 database. Molecular docking was conducted to the active components and targets related to the nuclear factor kappa B(NF-kappaB)/Toll-like receptor 4(TLR4) pathway. Finally, lipopolysaccharide(LPS) was used to induce BV2 cells to establish the model of AD neuroinflammation for in vitro experimental validation. In this study, 426 potential targets of active components of B. atrocarpa and 329 drug-disease common targets were obtained, and 14 key targets were screened out by PPI network. A total of 623 items and 112 items were obtained by GO functional enrichment analysis and KEGG pathway enrichment analysis, respectively. Molecular docking results showed that NF-kappaB, NF-kappaB inhibitor(IkappaB), TLR4, and myeloid differentiation primary response 88(MyD88) had good binding abilities to the active components, and malvidin-3-O-glucoside had the strongest binding ability. Compared with the model group, the concentration of nitric oxide(NO) decreased at different doses of malvidin-3-O-glucoside without affecting the cell survival rate. Meanwhile, malvidin-3-O-glucoside down-regulated the protein expressions of NF-kappaB, IkappaB, TLR4, and MyD88. This study uses network pharmacology and experimental verification to preliminarily reveal that B. atrocarpa anthocyanin can inhibit LPS-induced neuroinflammation by regulating the NF-kappaB/TLR4 signaling pathway, thereby achieving the effect against AD, which provides a theoretical basis for the study of its pharmacodynamic material basis and mechanism.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在基于网络药理学、分子对接技术和体外实验，探讨黑果小檗（Berberis atrocarpa Schneid.）花青素对抗阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）的潜在机制。利用数据库筛选出黑果小檗活性成分的潜在靶点及与AD相关的靶点。采用STRING数据库和Cytoscape 3.9.0构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络，并对共同靶点进行拓扑分析。使用DAVID 6.8数据库对靶点进行基因本体论（Gene Ontology, GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, KEGG）富集分析。对与核因子κB（nuclear factor kappa B, NF-κB）/Toll样受体4（Toll-like receptor 4, TLR4）通路相关的活性成分和靶点进行分子对接。最后，使用脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）诱导BV2细胞建立AD神经炎症模型，用于体外实验验证。本研究获得黑果小檗活性成分的426个潜在靶点和329个药物-疾病共同靶点，并通过PPI网络筛选出14个关键靶点。GO功能富集分析和KEGG通路富集分析分别获得623项和112项结果。分子对接结果显示，NF-κB、NF-κB抑制剂（IκB）、TLR4和髓样分化初级反应88（myeloid differentiation primary response 88, MyD88）与活性成分具有良好的结合能力，其中锦葵素-3-O-葡萄糖苷（malvidin-3-O-glucoside）的结合能力最强。与模型组相比，不同剂量的锦葵素-3-O-葡萄糖苷在不影响细胞存活率的情况下降低了一氧化氮（nitric oxide, NO）浓度。同时，锦葵素-3-O-葡萄糖苷下调了NF-κB、IκB、TLR4和MyD88的蛋白表达。本研究通过网络药理学和实验验证，初步揭示黑果小檗花青素可通过调节NF-κB/TLR4信号通路抑制LPS诱导的神经炎症，从而发挥抗AD作用，为其药效物质基础和作用机制研究提供理论依据。
